items.title: Silgan And American Industrial To Buy Trivium Packaging In $3.4bn Deal
items.summary: Silgan Holdings and private equity firm American Industrial Partners said they would buy Trivium Packaging in a $3.4 billion deal.

items.title: French riots damage 3,000 stores: Sephora closes all locations, Carrefour fears million-euro bill
items.summary: (updated) According to initial estimates, the violent protests in France have affected over 3,000 stores. Sephora, Burberry, Galeries Lafayette, and Carrefour, among others, were targeted by looting or vandalism.

items.title: Nestlé commits $1bn to North America expansion strategy
items.summary: Nestlé is investing $1bn in Mexico, as it expands production capacity, strengthens agricultural supply chains and accelerates its North American growth strategy.

items.title: Lindt & Sprüngli – CEO Departure, Leadership Changes In Germany, Austria
items.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli has announced the departure of CEO Adalbert Lechner and additional leadership changes in Germany and Austria.

items.title: Zalando brings on Amazon veteran to accelerate B2B
items.summary: Zalando aims to become the technological backbone of the European fashion retail industry. To realize this ambition, the e-commerce platform has brought in Tom Christenson as its new B2B CEO. He is tasked with better aligning the group’s logistics and software services and…

items.title: [In the picture] Yaya opens concept store in Ostend
items.summary: The Dutch fashion brand Yaya has just opened a new store in Ostend, the chain’s ninth location in Belgium. The opening marks the next step in the brand’s continued expansion into the European market.

items.title: Lindt ousts CEO in bid to reignite growth
items.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli has announced the departure of Group CEO Adalbert Lechner, with the Board citing the need for new leadership to restore growth. Former CEO Dieter Weisskopf returns as interim chief as the Swiss chocolatier searches for a successor.

items.title: Studenac Targets €16m In Annual Savings Through Logistics Overhaul
items.summary: Croatia's Studenac has advanced its pre-bankruptcy restructuring process by introducing changes to its supply chain and distribution model.

items.title: Nestlé India Reports Strong Volume Growth In Q2
items.summary: Nestlé India has reported strong volume growth across all product categories in Q2 2026/27, driven by innovation and investments.

items.title: Texas sues Nestlé’s Gerber over alleged heavy metals in baby food
items.summary: Attorney General Ken Paxton, who is in the midst of a high-profile Senate election, is seeking more than $10 million in penalties.

items.title: Primo Brands opens first new factory post merger
items.summary: The new Arkansas plant will produce more of sparkling water brand Mountain Valley as demand for premium beverages surges.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize was indeed hit by a hack: retailer files complaint
items.summary: The IT incident that affected Ahold Delhaize was, after all, a cyberattack, as evidenced by the fact that the retailer filed a complaint with the Dutch police on Monday. The company is now making progress in restoring all services to full operation.

items.title: Granarolo Secures €450m Loan, General Manager Filippo Marchi Resigns
items.summary: Italy’s Granarolo has finalised a €450 million sustainability-led financing agreement with a consortium of financial institutions.

items.title: Vinted flooded with stolen goods after riots in France
items.summary: From designer handbags to cosmetics: the secondhand marketplace Vinted is grappling with a wave of suspicious listings following the violent riots and looting in France last weekend. The company is mass-removing listings for luxury products that are suspected of coming from…

items.title: Vanden Borre Kitchen doubles revenue and aims for Belgium’s top three
items.summary: Vanden Borre Kitchen has more than doubled its revenue in four years. The kitchen specialist expects to grow by 10% again this year, despite challenging market conditions. By opening more stores, the chain aims to break into the top three in Belgium.

items.title: Double-digit growth for Mulberry
items.summary: The British luxury leather goods brand Mulberry reports strong sales growth, which the company attributes to investments in the brand and a reduction in price discounts.

items.title: Irish Shoppers Remained Cautious In The Run-Up To Budget - Worldpanel
items.summary: Irish shoppers exercised caution ahead of budget in the four weeks to 4 October, according to latest data from Worldpanel by Numerator.

items.title: Colruyt Group Receives Binding Offer From Carrefour For Codifrance
items.summary: Colruyt Group has received a binding offer from Carrefour for the sale of its French wholesale business Codifrance.

items.title: Too Good To Go Expands Into Non-Food Category
items.summary: Surplus food marketplace Too Good To Go is expanding its offering to include non-food categories.

items.title: Hagar Raises Full-Year Guidance After Strong Q2 Growth Across All Segments
items.summary: Icelandic retail group Hagar has raised its full-year earnings forecast following a strong Q2 in its 2026/27 financial year.

items.title: Safety First: Food supply risks, mycotoxins and COVID-19 side effects
items.summary: Food supply risks, mycotoxins and COVID-19 side effects feature in this edition of Safety First

items.title: APAC cocoa trends: ‘Worst is past’, but risks remain
items.summary: Cocoa giant Barry Callebaut says the worst of the cocoa crisis is likely over, but the APAC cocoa industry continues to navigate major market shifts and challenges

items.title: B&M Eyes Poundland Stores As Discount Chain Sale Process Gathers Pace - Sky News
items.summary: B&M is seeking to acquire a small number of stores from rival Poundland as part of any break-up of the struggling chain, Sky News reported.

items.title: Beyond Meat launches energy drink
items.summary: Beyond Meat has continued its diversification by launching an energy drink, Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy. The drink is a caffeinated version of its high protein drink Beyond Immerse.

items.title: Flemish Kringwinkel thrift stores celebrate 25th anniversary with a new baseline
items.summary: After 25 years, Kringwinkel is getting a new tagline and a more contemporary store concept. Under the slogan “Phenomenally Social,” the secondhand chain aims to communicate its social mission more clearly, while a revamped store design is intended to enhance the customer…

items.title: Mondelēz finds success beyond Oreo with nostalgic cookie brands
items.summary: The snack giant’s smaller cookie brands, such as Nutter Butter, Nilla Wafers and Honey Maid, are seeing a pickup in sales as consumers embrace familiarity.

items.title: Is functional food killing low carb – or absorbing it?
items.summary: The functional food boom has changed how consumers see health and wellness. Low carb as a trend has not declined, but it has changed, being folded into the wider functional space. Restrictive diets such as Paleo have declined.

items.title: Albert Heijn Restores Website And App Following Cybersecurity Incident
items.summary: Following a cybersecurity incident on 11 October, Albert Heijn has restored its website and app after a preventative shutdown.

items.title: 聚焦中国：蒙牛、伊利、替代蛋白阻力，以及塑造食品行业的趋势
items.summary: 从功能性乳制品与数字化，到替代蛋白，我们探讨中国食品行业的发展脉络、新兴趋势，以及那些正在塑造其未来的人。

items.title: China Focus: Mengniu, Yili, alt protein hurdles, and the trends shaping food
items.summary: From functional dairy and digitalisation to alternative proteins, we explore China’s food industry developments, emerging trends and the people shaping its future.
